name: cland
description: A terminal IDE for running and coordinating AI coding-agent harnesses.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace hub && node hub/bin/typecheck.ts -p nvim/tsconfig.json && node hub/bin/typecheck.ts -p shared/wire/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:lint
scripts.test:static: node hub/test/lint-copied-tracker.ts && node hub/test/lint-child-environment.ts && node hub/test/lint-dictionary-membership.ts && node hub/test/lint-tracker-container-source.ts && node hub/test/lint-repository-tier-plan.ts && node hub/test/lint-version-source.ts && node hub/test/lint-skill-provenance.ts && node hub/test/lint-web-workspace.ts && node hub/test/lint-wire-imports.ts
scripts.prepare: npm run build && npm run test:web:install
